last_completed_unit.target: Cargo --offline network behavior combined with the already-verified vendored source-replacement subclaim
last_completed_unit.finding: The official cargo(1) page states that --offline prevents Cargo itself from accessing the network and makes Cargo proceed using locally available data when possible; --frozen combines --locked with --offline. Combined with the prior role-local verified directory source-replacement pattern, this supports the narrow Cargo-internal no-network subclaim when all required dependency data is local.
last_completed_unit.verified_scope: Cargo's own network access can be disabled with --offline; with locally satisfiable dependency data, including a checked-in directory source replacement, Cargo can attempt dependency resolution/build orchestration without Cargo network access.
last_completed_unit.not_verified_scope: Network behavior of package build scripts/proc-macros/compiler wrappers or other spawned subprocesses; completeness of all dependency classes under the chosen local layout; Chat-native Cargo/rustc execution; end-to-end richer-mode parity.

source_scope: Current required repository controls for open_source, current own LATEST, SHA-only note-main identity, and exactly one official Cargo documentation page: https://doc.rust-lang.org/cargo/commands/cargo.html.
scope_guard: Do not broaden Cargo's documented --offline guarantee into arbitrary subprocess network isolation or actual Chat-native Cargo execution. The finding closes only Cargo-internal network access under locally satisfiable inputs.
